reply_text:
I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message. I told her the latest number I have is **166 seats**, but that it isn't confirmed yet.

- **Where 166 comes from:** gbrain has saved facts saying Ilse posted 163 seats in #north-team on Oct 14. Later that day she corrected it to 166 in #north-random, saying Thornbury's ops lead had corrected her. gbrain marks the two facts recording my replies to that correction as "unconfirmed".
- **Why it isn't confirmed:** I read the whole history of both channels and neither of Ilse's messages is there. There's also no Thornbury file in the shared drive. So I told Dana to check with Ilse before relying on 166.
- **Sharing:** Dana is a member of both channels, so I only drew on what she could see herself. A seat count is an account fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to post in the team channel.
